hypotheses.justification: hc₂ is implied by the other hypotheses. T is nonempty (hTne) and each F t is nonempty (hFn), so pick t ∈ T and e ∈ F t. Put w = Y (G.left e) - Y (G.right e). Then c₁ ≤ (w.ofLp e)^2 by hmin. Also (w.ofLp e)^2 ≤ ‖w‖^2, because ‖w.ofLp e‖ ≤ ‖w‖ by PiLp.norm_apply_le in Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Lp/PiLp.lean, together with sq_abs. Then ‖w‖^2 ≤ l1dist (X (G.left e)) (X (G.right e)) by hcontract, and l1dist (X (G.left e)) (X (G.right e)) ≤ c₂ by hdmax. So 0 < c₁ ≤ c₂. hc₂ is not mentioned in any other binder or in the conclusion, so the statement elaborates and stays true without it. In the proof, add `have hc₂ : 0 < c₂ := ...` right after the nonemptiness facts, using this chain. Every later use of hc₂ (the thresholds call and the hcover step) then works unchanged.
